lead: Turn a video you want to watch into language you want to use. Repeat a phrase, check its meaning, and keep useful words for practice in 2000nl.
access: A Chrome extension prototype running on YouTube. Not yet available as a public release.
listenBody: Hear real speech, replay a phrase and say it back. Shadowing gives you a small, repeatable moment to practise pronunciation and rhythm.
understandBody: Show a translation when you need it. Click a word in the phrase to explore its dictionary meaning and examples without leaving the video.
keepBody: With a connected 2000nl account, start learning a useful word from its card. Return to it later in your vocabulary practice.
phraseEyebrow: A little less scrubbing. A little more speaking.
phraseBody: Move back, repeat, or go forward. Hide the original when you want to test yourself, and reveal it when you need support.
phraseMore: The prototype explores Shadow and Recall modes, phrase translation and adjustable playback speed.
dictionaryTitleFirst: From a word in a video
dictionaryFirst: The dictionary card is part of the same vocabulary world as
dictionaryLast: . Read a definition, see an example, and choose to learn the word.
dictionaryMore: Our own Dutch learner’s dictionary, Dilum Nederlands, is already connected in the test prototype.
statusBody: This is an experimental prototype, connected to 2000nl for testing. Playback, subtitles, translations and the interface are still being refined. It is not a finished product or a public extension-store release.
statusMore: Interested in trying it or helping shape it?
statusContact: Get in touch about early testing ↗
workspaceAlt: AudioFilms prototype on YouTube, with a Dutch video, phrase replay controls and dictionary cards for ziekenhuis, including Dilum Nederlands.
ribbonAlt: AudioFilms phrase ribbon with clickable Dutch words, Shadow and Recall modes, Previous, Repeat and Next buttons, and translation controls.
dictionaryAlt: The Dilum Nederlands card for het ziekenhuis in AudioFilms, with a definition, example sentence and Start Learning button.
metaDescription: An experimental Chrome extension for practising language with YouTube: replay phrases, explore meanings and connect useful words to 2000nl. In development.
